name: opennow-workspace
description: OpenNOW Qt/native desktop workspace and repository tooling

scripts.build: npm run qt:configure && npm run qt:build
scripts.native:check: cargo check --manifest-path native/opennow-core/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path native/opennow-streamer/Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.native:build: cargo build --manifest-path native/opennow-core/Cargo.toml && cargo build --manifest-path native/opennow-streamer/Cargo.toml -p opennow-streamer-ffi
